links.comparator_used: Unprompted LLM outputs with no reading-level instruction
links.outcome: Readability scores of LLM-generated patient education materials on chronic conditions
links.effect: Prompting for a 5th-grade level consistently produced statistically lower readability scores than unprompted outputs; no numeric values reported in the abstract
links.quote: Prompting LLMs to produce PEMs at a 5th-grade level consistently produced statistically lower readability scores than unprompted outputs.
